Bring your questions

Understand the next step

A participation certificate is not a clinical qualification. Coaching does not guarantee customers, income or business success.

Questions worth asking

Plan your learning.

Which skincare products will be used?+
The promotion refers to Elysyle. Ask Farra which exact products and tools are included in your session, and discuss any sensitivities before practical work.
Are skincare products included in RM69?+
The poster does not fully specify take-home products or equipment. Confirm all inclusions and any optional purchases before registering.
Can I join to learn for myself?+
Tell Farra your goal when enquiring, whether you are exploring personal learning or a possible mobile spa business.
